Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.gitgui

Class GitResult

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.gitgui.GitResult
public final class GitResult extends Object
The immutable outcome of running one git invocation: whether the process actually started, its exit code, and its captured stdout / stderr.

This is the AWT-free value type the whole Git GUI backend speaks in. It deliberately distinguishes "could not even start" (git missing from PATH) from "started and returned a non-zero exit code" (a real git error such as a merge conflict or a rejected push), so the panel can surface honest guidance instead of a fake success.
